exposure: Intrathecal fentanyl (15 mg) with spinal anesthesia
Intravenous ondansetron (8 mg) with usual saline solution
Intravenous fluid before spinal anesthesia and intrathecal bupivacaine without fentanyl (control group)
cohort: The study included pregnant women scheduled for cesarean section under intrathecal anesthesia.
finding: The incidence of shivering was significantly lower in both the fentanyl and ondansetron groups compared to the control group, indicating effectiveness in reducing shivering during spinal anesthesia.
